integrity: Exact all-order proof and finite independent enumeration checker embedded; no external mathematical audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the one-sorted generic transitive-triangle-free oriented graph and individually named K_{3,b} bases with b>=1. No theorem for K_{a,b}, a>=4, or multi-types. title: Coefficientwise extremality and mod-six balanced orientations of complete bipartite one-point type bases
